## Detailed Program Directory

### 1. MERN Stack Development + AI Integration
- **Duration**: 4–6 Months
- **Format**: Live Hybrid / Offline Noida Campus
- **Key Modules**: HTML5/CSS3, Modern JavaScript ES6+, React 19, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, OpenAI/Gemini API integration.
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/mern-stack-development

### 2. Data Science & Machine Learning Core
- **Duration**: 5–6 Months
- **Format**: Live Hybrid / Offline Noida Campus
- **Key Modules**: Python, Data Wrangling, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, MLOps deployment.
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-science-machine-learning

### 3. Java Full Stack Developer Program
- **Duration**: 4–6 Months
- **Format**: Live Hybrid / Offline Noida Campus
- **Key Modules**: Java 21 Core, OOPs, Data Structures & Algorithms, Spring Boot 3, Microservices Architecture, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL, Docker, React frontend.
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/java-full-stack

### 4. Cloud Computing & DevOps Infrastructure
- **Duration**: 4–5 Months
- **Format**: Live Hybrid / Offline Noida Campus
- **Key Modules**: Linux Administration, AWS Services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, ECS), Docker Containerization, Kubernetes Orchestration, Terraform Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD with Jenkins & GitHub Actions.
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/cloud-devops

### 5. Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
- **Duration**: 3–4 Months
- **Format**: Live Hybrid / Offline Noida Campus
- **Key Modules**: Advanced SQL, PostgreSQL, Python for Analytics, Power BI Dashboarding, Tableau, Advanced Excel, ETL Data Pipelines, Business Storytelling.
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-analytics
